title: Understanding Interval Notation
text:
For $x < 4$:
- x can be any value less than 4
- x cannot equal 4 (strict inequality)
- x extends to negative infinity

title: Writing Interval Notation
text:
Interval notation format: (lower bound, upper bound)
- Round bracket ( means "not included"
- Square bracket [ means "included"
- Infinity always uses round bracket

For $x < 4$: $(-\infty, 4)$

title: Final Answer
text:
In interval notation: $(-\infty, 4)$

On a number line:
```
<--------o
         4
```
Open circle at 4, arrow extending left.
